title: Queer NLP: A Critical Survey on Literature Gaps, Biases and Trends

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review of NLP research evaluating homophobia and anti-queer bias using methods such as template-based prompting, intrinsic probability scoring, sentiment analysis, and hate speech classification.

Systematic literature review of NLP research evaluating transphobia, cisnormativity, and misgendering through tasks like coreference resolution with neopronouns, gender-fair machine translation, and speech processing assessments.
